jobs.title: Senior GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
To be a team member at ADB Companies, or as we call it, part of the A\-Team, you must be **ALL IN** to support the company’s mission, vision, and values.


**OUR MISSION:** We are a customer\-centric partner providing innovative solutions. The safety, well\-being, and career growth of our team members are the benchmarks of our success.



**POSITION TITLE:** Senior GIS Specialist


**REPORTS TO:** Director, Engineering


**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt


**POSITION OVERVIEW:**



ADB is a Nationwide full turnkey provider of technology infrastructure solutions including Wireline, Wireless, Technology, Critical Infrastructure, and Engineering. Our customer centric approach has ensured long\-term relationships with commercial clients, service providers, local, state, and federal government organizations. We recognize our team members as our greatest asset, ensuring that their safety, well\-being, and career growth are always our number one priority. Our **ALL IN** culture includes a focus on Safety, Wellness, Learning, Diversity and Inclusion, and giving back to our communities.



ADB Companies is hiring a GIS Specialist to sit inside the Engineering organization and support fiber and OSP infrastructure delivery across a growing portfolio of carrier, utility, and municipal client programs. The person in this seat will directly support designers, permitting technicians, and business development, while helping establish repeatable GIS standards, integrations, and data workflows that drive efficiency across ADB’s project mix.



This is a hands\-on role. This role will spend the majority of the time producing, validating, and improving geospatial data that engineering and permitting teams depend on daily. This role will also work alongside ADB’s data science team and IT organization on shared infrastructure buildout, allowing focused capacity on engineering\-specific priorities and deliver efficiency where it matters most to project execution.


**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Build, maintain, and quality\-control GIS data layers supporting OSP fiber design projects, including route alignments, existing utilities, easements, right\-of\-way, parcels, permitting boundaries, and as\-built information
* Develop and perform GIS QA/QC checks for geometry, attribution, topology, coordinate systems, completeness, and client\-specific requirements before data is released to engineering teams or delivered externally
* Interpret construction plans, as\-builts, recorded maps, deeds, legal descriptions, and imagery, and translate them into accurate GIS layers using COGO, digitizing, and standard geoprocessing workflows
* Support permitting workflows by producing exhibits, application maps, and jurisdictional overlays used in submissions to municipalities, DOTs, railroads, and utility joint\-use partners
* Produce route mockups, feasibility exhibits, and market maps that support business development pursuits and proposals
* Acquire, integrate, and curate third\-party geospatial datasets, including utility, parcel, address, imagery, and jurisdictional sources, maintaining schema, data dictionary, and attribute consistency across engineering, permitting, and BD workflows
* Support the setup and ongoing maintenance of enterprise GIS services, including map services, feature services, and hosted layers, that make ADB geospatial data accessible to internal teams and clients through web maps and other endpoints
* Support the buildout and maintenance of API\-based integrations between ADB GIS environments and client systems, so spatial data flows cleanly without manual handoffs
* Support interoperability between GIS and adjacent design and construction platforms including AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Render Networks, ensuring engineering deliverables move cleanly across tools
* Maintain client\-specific data conventions, layer standards, schemas, and file structures across multiple concurrent programs, ensuring deliverables meet each client’s specifications
* Develop and document repeatable GIS standards, templates, data dictionaries, and workflows for the engineering team. Contribute to a growing standards library so that GIS practices are consistent, defensible, and efficient across projects and PMs
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tasks and drive delivery efficiency, including data cleanup, exhibit generation, integration, and reporting
* Coordinate with designers, project managers, permitting technicians, and subcontractors to align GIS outputs with project needs and schedule


**SUCCESS FACTORS:**


* A strong belief in ZERO — Being safe 100% of the time is the expectation
* Alignment with company mission, vision, and values
* A high level of customer centricity
* Ability to perform in a fast\-paced work environment
* A high level of time management, accountability, and prioritization skills
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented, and driven to accomplish department goals
* Ability to be organized, problem solve, and be solution oriented
* Strong ability to influence desired outcomes by master relationship building
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail; this role will be trusted with data that feeds design, permitting, and client\-facing decisions
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects across different clients without losing context.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, etc.)


**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**


* This role operates out of a temperature\-controlled office environment
* This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and cell phones


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS:**


* GIS deliverables to designers, permitting, and BD are consistent, accurate, and produced on schedule without rework
* A documented set of ADB GIS standards, templates, schemas, and data dictionaries exists and is being used across projects and PMs
* Third\-party spatial datasets are integrated, curated, and accessible without ad

jobs.title: GIS Coordinator
jobs.description:
* 543522
* PHOENIX
* DEPT OF TRANSPORTATION
* Full\-time
* Closing at: Sep 14 2026 \- 23:55 MST
**DEPT OF TRANSPORTATION**
==========================


***Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team driving a safer transportation system for Arizona.***
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


### **GIS Coordinator**


Job Location:
#### **MPD Planning Team**
**1611 W Jackson St**
**Phoenix, AZ 85007**


Posting Details:
#### **Salary: $101,970\.00**

#### **Grade: 25**

#### **Closing Date: Sep 14, 2026**

Job Summary:
The GIS Coordinator, supports the Multimodal Planning Division (MPD) in a management role of the Enterprise Data Programs and Outreach team. This position is responsible for overseeing the outreach activities for the acquisition, creation, dissemination, coordination, visualization, governance, maintenance and reporting of geospatially enabled enterprise data. The position will function as a liaison between data owners and management and will provide subject matter expertise of the GIS within the context of programs and outreach initiatives to management.



This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.



The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.



Job Duties:
Manages and leads professional employees under the general direction of the GIS Group Manager and is responsible for the supervision of the Enterprise Data Programs and Outreach team.  

  

Conduct outreach with business units and data owners to understand and document data challenges. Partner with the Information Technology Group (ITG) to evaluate new and existing GIS applications and databases. Promote good data governance practices by enabling data to be visualized and managed in a geospatial data format for improved analytical capabilities and life cycle analysis.  

  

Develops and disperse technical documentation include workflows, metadata, training curriculum, status reports and other analytical documentation to ADOT and external customers. Identify and develop policy/standards for implementation throughout the agency to promote sustainability planning and knowledge management.



Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities (KSAs):
**Knowledge of:**


* Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
* Planning principles, practices and procedures for maintenance of geospatial enabled data.
* Intricacies of geospatial data and the ability to analyze via transportation applications.
* Esri based GIS software tools (ArcGIS Pro) and workflows.
* Implementing innovative technologies such as AI.


**Skill in:**


* Computers and computer programming, including languages.
* Technical documentation development best practices.
* Writing and orally communicating, including report preparation and making presentations.
* Successfully conduct research and data analysis for improving data and systems.
* Ability to perform outreach with data owners and custodians.


**Ability to:**


* Utilize GIS databases for analysis tools and GIS applications.
* Interact with superiors, peers, officials and representatives of other agencies and the public.
* Project management and budgetary updates.
* Effectively communicate and interact with superiors, officials and the public on technical topics.
Selective Preference(s):
GIS Professional certification.



Pre\-Employment Requirements:
Bachelor Degree in Geography, Urban Planning, GIS or related field. Minimum of five (5\) years of GIS experience.



This position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job, and the following requirements apply. Any employee operating a motor vehicle on State business must possess and retain a current, valid class\-appropriate driver’s license, complete all required training, and successfully pass all necessary driver’s license record checks. The license must be current, unexpired, and neither revoked nor suspended. Employees who drive on state business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records, and must complete all required driver training. An employee who operates a personally owned vehicle on state business shall maintain the statutorily required liability insurance (see Arizona Administrative Code (A.A.C.) R2\-10\-207\.11\).



All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E\-Verify).



Benefits:
The Arizona Department of Administration offers a comprehensive benefits package to include:
  

* Sick leave
* Vacation with 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid Parental Leave\-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly\-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program).
* Health and dental insurance
* Retirement plan
* Life insurance and long\-term disability insurance
* Optional employee benefits include short\-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance
  

By providing the option of a full\-time or part\-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.


*Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program* *here**. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our* *benefits page*



Retirement:
Mandatory participation in the Ari

jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**  

The Geospatial Analyst will work with senior consulting and technical staff to design work plans that define project deliverables, milestones, and schedules. The qualified candidate will work with company staff to ensure progress and financial reporting is provided per contract requirements as well as manage the delivery of projects. Tasks that may be assigned to this position may include, but not limited to:
* Conduct requirements interview process
* Documents application requirements
* Managing small teamwork efforts utilizing industry standards and methodologies (i.e., Agile Scrum process, Waterfall, etc.)
* Provide tactical recommendations to government to affect improvements in processes, deliverables, and outcomes


  

**REQUIREMENTS**
* Requires a MA/MS degree in Geography, GIS, or related field with 4\+ years of specialized experience, BA/BS with 6\+ years of specialized experience, or 9\+ years of experience in lieu of a degree
* Ability to obtain background check and maintain a Client Clearance
* Specialized experience in support and development of enterprise GIS solutions
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to work independently and take initiative
* Willing to give technical demonstrations to leadership and supporting conferences
* Experience working with, ArcGIS Pro, AGOL, and Portal for ArcGIS
* Experience working with ArcGIS web applications
* Knowledge of Python scripting techniques (Preferred)


  

*Integrity is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is dedicated to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee for employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*
